title: The Winter Wonderland - Spiti
description: This album captures the serene beauty of Spiti Valley in winter, where snow blankets the rugged landscapes and the villages stand in quiet solitude. Amidst the harsh, awe-inspiring environment, we were fortunate to encounter the elusive snow leopard, as well as a variety of other remarkable wildlife species that call this remote region home. Each photograph tells the story of the harsh yet breathtaking landscape, where nature's raw beauty and its hidden inhabitants come to life in the heart of winter.
details:
Trip to Spiti from New Delhi
31st Jan to 9th Feb 2025

title: Birds in Flight
description:
This collection captures the breathtaking beauty and dynamic energy of birds in flight. From the graceful glide of an eagle to the swift, powerful wings of a kestrel, each image offers a unique moment of freedom and strength. The interplay of light, air, and movement showcases the elegance these remarkable creatures embody as they navigate the skies.
Through these photographs, I invite you to pause and appreciate the natural world from a new perspective, marvelling at the fluidity and wonder of birds as they soar above the landscapes they call home.

title: Avian Portraits
description: Every bird has a story to tell, and their expressions, colours, and textures reveal fascinating details. This series focuses on close-up portraits, celebrating the intricate patterns of feathers, the intensity of piercing eyes, and the subtle nuances of their postures. Through these portraits, I aim to showcase the individuality and majesty of each species.

title: Wings & Water
description: Some of the most mesmerising bird photography happens where air meets water. This collection captures birds interacting with lakes, rivers, and oceans, whether it's a kingfisher plunging into a river, a flamingo wading elegantly, or a seabird skimming the waves. The reflections, ripples, and splashes add an extra dimension of artistry to each image.

title: Mammals in the Wild
description: While my primary focus is on birds, the untamed beauty of mammals is equally captivating. This collection features candid moments of wildlife in their natural habitats, whether it's the cunning gaze of a fox, the quiet strength of a wolf, or the elusive grace of a snow leopard navigating its icy realm. These images showcase the resilience, adaptability, and raw beauty of mammals in the wild.

title: Landscapes of the Wild
description: Nature isn't just about the creatures that inhabit it, it's also about the breathtaking scenery they call home. This collection presents sweeping vistas, dramatic skies, and untouched wilderness, capturing the soul of the places I've travelled to. Each image tells a story of space, solitude, and the ever-changing moods of nature.
